title: ProximityPrompt
summary: The modern interaction prompt: shows '[E] Hold to Revive' style UI when players approach, works on PC/console/mobile, supports hold durations, and fires Triggered on the server. Successor to ClickDetector for most interactions.

properties.name: HoldDuration
properties.description: Seconds the input must be held (0 = instant).

properties.name: Enabled / RequiresLineOfSight / Exclusivity
properties.description: Toggles, LOS requirement, and how multiple prompts compete for one button.

properties.name: ClickablePrompt
properties.description: Whether it can also be clicked like a ClickDetector.

events.name: Triggered
events.description: Fires (server and client) when the interaction completes. Passes the Player.

events.name: PromptShown / PromptHidden
events.description: Client: when the prompt appears/disappears for the local player.

events.name: PromptButtonHoldBegan / PromptButtonHoldEnded
events.description: Client: hold start/cancel tracking for custom UI.

details.heading: ProximityPromptService
details.body: Game-wide prompt limits and styling live in ProximityPromptService (MaxPromptsVisible etc.).

explanation.whatItIs: Roblox's built-in 'press E to interact' system — with mobile buttons, gamepad support, hold timers, and clean visuals for free.
explanation.whyItExists: Every game reinvented hover prompts badly; ProximityPrompt standardized them across all platforms.
whenToUse: Doors, chests, NPCs, vehicles, revives — anything approachable
Cross-platform interaction with zero input code
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Part + ProximityPrompt
   ActionText="Open"  ObjectText="Chest"
   HoldDuration=1

Player approaches → [E] Open Chest appears
Holds E for 1s → Triggered(player)
```
tips: Keep server logic in Triggered — it fires server-side with the real Player
Disable the prompt temporarily for cooldowns: prompt.Enabled = false
Use PromptButtonHoldBegan client-side for progress circles during holds
commonMistakes: Listening to Triggered only in a LocalScript — exploiters can spoof it; keep consequences server-side
Too many visible prompts cluttering the screen — ProximityPromptService limits help

examples.title: Hold-to-open chest
examples.code:
-- Setup (server Script):
local chest = workspace.Chest
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open"
prompt.ObjectText = "Chest"
prompt.HoldDuration = 1.5
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
prompt.Parent = chest

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    prompt.Enabled = false            -- one open per chest
    print(player.Name .. " opened the chest")
    -- loot logic here…
end)
